name: ramalama-runtime-compatibility-preflight-reports
instr:
Ramalama cannot preflight whether a selected runtime can execute a resolved model on the requested host. Add an offline preflight whose authoritative result governs run, serve, and deployment output without changing successful commands, readiness, or unrelated output.

Normalize GGUF and safetensor inspection while preserving all format-specific evidence. Turn malformed metadata into diagnostics, not parser failures. Reports distinguish supported, unsupported, and indeterminate outcomes, retain every distinct reason, and sort diagnostics lexicographically by (code, severity, subject, message), making equivalent explicit offline evidence equal. LlamaCppPlugin, MlxPlugin, and VllmPlugin must enforce the artifact, host, accelerator, image, naming, and execution constraints of their constructed commands. RuntimeCompatibilityRequest.options carries llama.cpp backend, container_only, image_compatible, projection_required, and projection evidence and vLLM served_model_name and model_name evidence.

Assess only the selected runtime. assess_runtime from ramalama.plugins.loader preserves its complete report and the established unknown-name lookup failure. `CompatibilityFormat` is a str and an Enum. CompatibilityFormat and render_compatibility from ramalama.compatibility_render render human and JSON output deterministically. compatibility_cli(args) from ramalama.cli, where args.report is a RuntimeCompatibilityReport and args.compatibility_format selects the output format, distinguishes
